meta.purpose: Canonical store registry. Every incoming document must match its claimed store on at least TWO identity fields (legal_entity, store_code, address_fragment, bank_accounts) or it goes to Quarantine/. All entities, addresses, banks and people here are synthetic.
meta.instructions: One block per store. legal_entity exactly as printed on the P&L cover page; address_fragment as printed in the document header; bank_accounts as the bank name printed on the bank reconciliation. Run tools/validate_registry.js after every edit.

status_field.active: Fully analyzed: baseline maintained, row in the completeness matrix, monthly review at its tier.
status_field.filed-only: Identified, renamed and archived into Stores/SXX/YYYY-MM/, but not analyzed. Promote to active by seeding a baseline from the archive.

tier_field.light: Learn-and-store pass while the baseline builds. Auto-graduates to active at 3 months of history.

intake.mode: Forwarded mail to a dedicated plus-address
intake.intake_address: set in Apps Script Script Properties (INTAKE_ADDRESS); never committed
